evidence.title: One Inverse Step is a Convex Program: Bayes-Limit Calibration of Diffusion Inversion

summary: Researchers demonstrate that performing just one inverse step in diffusion model inversion can be expressed as a convex optimization problem, allowing precise Bayes‑limit calibration. The new formulation offers theoretical guarantees and improves inversion accuracy in experiments.
title: Single-Step Diffusion Inversion Reformulated as Convex Program for Bayes‑Limit Calibration
